entries.0344e37b440a8faa: It is advancing its 8th Medium-Term Management Plan, 'KAWAI Ten-Year Plan', which covers the ten years from April 2025 to March 2035. Aiming to become 'the world's leading keyboard instrument maker,' the company is working on quality improvement, brand awareness and expansion of sales channels, with the highest priority on raising the value added of products and increasing market share in mature markets. In parallel with growth in the keyboard instrument business, the company is also working to build its next growth engine and improve capital efficiency.

entries.94a0432a7c903dd2: The Musical Instrument and Education Business accounts for most of consolidated revenue. Segment revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥56,492 million for the Musical Instrument and Education Business, ¥10,343 million for the Material Processing Business and ¥5,213 million for Other Business. By region, revenue was ¥46,176 million in Japan, ¥10,121 million in Europe, ¥6,968 million in North America, ¥4,981 million in China and ¥3,801 million in other regions, and there is no major customer accounting for 10% or more of revenue. Consolidated employees number 2,917, and there are 23 consolidated subsidiaries. The company has a business alliance with Gakken Holdings and a capital and business alliance with Parsons Music Corporation.
